items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And man, we did stuff with Ella Fitzgerald, we did stuff with Satchmo, Louis Armstrong man.

ctx.x: Bundles of stuff. And man, we did stuff with Ella Fitzgerald, we did stuff with Satchmo, Louis Armstrong man. I mean I’m sitting there behind the drums and there’s Louis. You know? Singing about tires, Goodyear Tires or something. And Ella singing some tune swinging, all swinging stuff you know but that was a highlight for me in that business was playing with them.
